prompt: Make these calls sequentially: inspect-listeners, exactly one play-session-and-listen for the supplied MIDI Session target with durationBeats 1, maximumDurationMs 30000 and only the supplied listener ID, then get-pass once with the returned passId. The runner explicitly requests level, spectral-centroid and attacks. Use only the new v5 independent-metric pipeline. If a call fails, stop and report it: do not retry, repair, seek, stop playback, change settings, edit the Set or use another listener. After the first get-pass, if it is nonterminal, immediately finish your turn with pending. Never call get-pass twice, poll or wait: the harness owns the terminal wait. Only after completed may you get the context with includeHistorical=true. Leave playback running. Report measured level, spectral-centroid and attack availability without claiming exclusive clip audio. This is one of three separately authorized one-beat captures of the SAME immutable MIDI source and SAME loaded native5 producer. Do not start another capture in this turn. Only the harness may establish exactly two stopped, recording-off beat-zero baselines after verified completed captures; it never reinstalls, reloads or rebinds the producer. Stop at the first failure, denial or cancellation; no later capture is authorized. Descriptive clock disagreement is advisory, not a sample-accuracy admission gate. Constant 120 BPM is assumed; tempo automation is unsupported. Final capture cleanup leaves playback running.

setupContract.processPolicy: One fresh exact-PID runner-owned Live 11 and isolated profile for all three subpasses. Refuse existing Live. Hash-pinned copied fixture only. Same loaded native5 producer, instance, registration, connection and connection epoch; increasing per-pass native epochs. No reinstall, reload, rebind, source edits or retries. Exactly two harness-only resets after independently verified completed captures: stop exact-track clips unquantized, stop transport, seek beat0, independently verify stopped0/recording-off/no queued launch and unchanged content/settings. Actors have no stop/seek/repair authority. Final capture cleanup leaves playback running; runner teardown closes only its owned process.
setupContract.reviewStatus: Bounded deterministic repeated-use contract; real-Live qualification remains parent-owned. Requires staged hash-pinned native5 candidate copied from existing immutable cohort-audio-fixture provisioned-input.json. No synthetic evidence is physical/acoustic qualification.
